system.name: Apollo
system.one_liner: A study of what drives video understanding in large multimodal models (sampling, encoder, data mix, training schedule, evaluation), leading to the Apollo family of video-LMMs.

content.variant_note: a plain video-LMM sketch (LLM bar, token squares, encoder, frames) with five colour-coded design questions attached to the parts they concern
content.argues: Many video-specific design choices of a video-LMM, from frame sampling to evaluation, are open questions that the paper examines one by one.
content.subject: A video-LMM sketch with sampled dog-video frames, an encoder and connector, token squares under an LLM bar, and five design questions.

new_tags.name: question-annotated-model
new_tags.what: research questions in coloured italic boxes attached to the parts of a plain model sketch that they ask about

lessons.what_to_learn: To map the axes of a study, keep the model sketch plain and attach each design question as a colour-coded italic box on the part it concerns; use inline emoji such as a snowflake and a flame to say freeze or unfreeze inside the sentence.
lessons.suits: Empirical or analysis papers that vary several design axes of one system and want a single-glance map of the questions.

evidence: Caption: a schematic of the exploration of video-specific design choices, from video sampling and model architecture to training schedules and data compositions.
Abstract: the study covers video sampling, architectures, data composition and training schedules.

summary: Apollo is a study of what drives video understanding in large multimodal models, ending in a family of video-LMMs. Figure 1 is a map of the design space on a plain model sketch. A grey LLM bar sits over a row of light-blue video-token squares and a row of grey text-token squares. Under them four skewed dog-video frames feed an encoder and connector, and a dashed box holds a text query. Five colour-coded italic boxes ask the open questions: how to sample videos (green), how to resample tokens and whether a video encoder is needed (blue), the best data mixture shown by text, image and video icons (orange), how many training stages and what to freeze (yellow), and how to evaluate (purple).
summary_zh: Apollo 研究视频理解在大型多模态模型中由什么驱动。图用一个简单的模型草图承载五个彩色提问框：视频采样、编码器与连接器、数据配比、训练计划（冻结与解冻）、评测协议，并配有狗视频帧、令牌方块和图标。
notes: No paragraph of the paper mentions the figure, so roles come from the caption, abstract and drawing. The meaning of the two token-square colours is inferred from the neighbouring boxes. The five question boxes could also be read as a paper roadmap (contribution-mosaic), but they pose questions and carry no findings.
